summary: Updated implementation_plan.md to match the Corrected Master V1 Implementation Plan, including the exact Section 4 canonical 12-table database contract (habits without duplicate lifecycle fields, habit_versions with version_id/name/lifecycle_state, habit_entries with entry_id/value_units without redundant canonical_amount, journal_drafts with nullable intended_journal_entry_id assigned on save preparation, restore_conflicts with UNIQUE(restore_session_id, record_type, record_key) and no status/mask columns, notification_cancel_outbox with cancel_id/status/error_category), plus the Section 2.1 preflight requirement classification matrix.
